← Motor control

Update firmware

Current required version: 1.0.3. Each connected controller shows its running version and build. ⚠ means an older or unverified version. Updating is optional for connecting; it does not block controls.

  1. Open firmware builds. Choose a successful build from the same branch as this site (main for production).
  2. Under Artifacts, download the matching board image: motorcontrol-rp2040-nema23_drv8452 for NEMA23, motorcontrol-rp2040-drv8825 for NEMA17 PCB 1.0.42, or motorcontrol-rp2040-nema17_drv8847 for older NEMA17 boards. Unzip it. GitHub sign-in may be needed.
  3. Disconnect motor power and programming USB. Hold BOOTSEL while reconnecting programming USB.
  4. Copy motorcontrol.uf2 onto the RPI-RP2 drive in Finder or your file manager. The board restarts automatically.
  5. Reconnect on the site and check the displayed version. Update each controller separately.

There is currently no browser flashing button; the browser downloads the firmware and your file manager copies it to the board.
